design_selection: On the initial forward passage (2–15 s), select the common FR-to-RR key with the largest smaller exact overlap in x [0.9,1.49), y [-0.24,-0.04). Observed overlap was small; success requires a fresh release, the declared gap and positive physical intersection inside the fixed cell. Heldout uses a fixed 26-cell eastward translation, new initial episodes and the same body control.
task: Twelve forward attempts plus eleven return transfers. A fixed ground footprint is aimed at twice by the front and hind right leg via shared body waypoints derived from prior stance offsets. No foot or grid is moved; pending swings retain their committed XY. Count every missed target. Direct passes have (0,3) s, recovered passes require both at least 6 s continuous clearance and a measured source-to-target gap of at least 6 s. Hold the ordinary home condition.
original_route: Count every source load including no release, no following reload and nonpositive overlap. Each intended circuit also has 7 longitude bands (0.8 to 2.2 at 0.2 m) x 2 world sides x outbound/return, including unentered phases and all zeros.
legacy: Old 12-target v1/v2 results and W58 model-development data remain in their original roles.
